recipes.title: Rajma Chawal
steps: Soak rajma overnight, then pressure-cook with salt for 6–7 whistles until soft.
Heat ghee, splutter cumin, then fry onion until deep golden.
Add ginger garlic paste, chilli, tomato and the powdered spices; cook until oil separates.
Add rajma with its water, mash a few beans, and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Cook the rice separately and serve hot with rajma and coriander.

recipes.title: Chole
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight; pressure-cook with salt and a tea bag for colour, 5–6 whistles.
Fry onion in oil until brown; add ginger garlic paste and chilli.
Add tomato and chole masala; cook down to a thick masala.
Add chickpeas with some cooking water and simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, cool in cold water and blend with green chilli.
Heat ghee, add cumin, onion and ginger garlic paste; cook until soft.
Add tomato, then the spinach purée and salt; simmer 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and garam masala; finish with cream.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Simmer tomato, onion and cashews in a little water for 10 minutes, then blend smooth.
Melt butter, fry ginger garlic paste, add the purée and chilli powder; cook 8 minutes.
Add salt, sugar, garam masala and crushed kasuri methi.
Add paneer and cream; simmer 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Matar Paneer
steps: Fry cumin and onion until golden; add ginger garlic paste.
Add tomato and powdered spices; cook until the masala thickens.
Add peas and a cup of water; simmer 8 minutes.
Add paneer and garam masala; simmer 3 minutes more.

recipes.title: Dal Makhani
steps: Soak urad dal and rajma overnight; pressure-cook until very soft, about 8 whistles.
Melt butter, fry onion and ginger garlic paste, then add tomato purée and chilli powder.
Add the dal, mash lightly, and simmer on low for 40 minutes, stirring often.
Finish with cream, garam masala and kasuri methi.

recipes.title: Kadhi Pakora
steps: Whisk curd, 4 tbsp besan, turmeric, salt and 4 cups water until smooth.
Mix remaining besan with sliced onion, chilli and salt into a thick batter; fry spoonfuls into pakoras.
Bring the kadhi to a boil, stirring constantly, then simmer 20 minutes.
Temper mustard, fenugreek, red chilli, curry leaves and asafoetida in hot oil; pour over and add pakoras.

recipes.title: Baingan Bharta
steps: Roast the large brinjal over a flame until charred and soft; peel and mash.
Fry cumin, garlic, onion and chilli until golden.
Add tomato and chilli powder; cook until soft.
Add the mashed brinjal and salt; cook 5 minutes and finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Bhindi Masala
steps: Wash and dry okra completely, then cut into pieces.
Fry okra in half the oil until no longer sticky; set aside.
Fry cumin and onion, add tomato and spices, then return okra and amchur; cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Sabzi
steps: Chop all vegetables into even pieces.
Fry cumin and onion, add tomato and spices.
Add vegetables and a splash of water; cover and cook 15 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Aloo Matar
steps: Fry cumin, onion and grated ginger; add tomato and spices.
Add cubed potatoes, peas and 2 cups water.
Pressure-cook 2 whistles or simmer covered until potatoes are soft; finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Dum Aloo
steps: Boil baby potatoes until just done, peel, prick and shallow-fry until golden.
Whisk curd with chilli, fennel and ginger powders.
Temper cloves, cardamom and asafoetida; lower the heat and stir in the curd mix.
Add potatoes and a little water; cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.
Fry whole spices and onion in ghee; add vegetables.
Add rice, salt and 3 cups water; cook covered until done.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Marinate vegetables in curd, biryani masala, ginger garlic paste and salt for 20 minutes.
Fry sliced onions in ghee until crisp; keep half for topping.
Par-boil rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Layer vegetables, rice, mint, coriander, fried onion and saffron milk; seal and cook on low for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Moong Dal Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and moong dal together.
Heat ghee, add cumin, asafoetida and grated ginger.
Add rice, dal, turmeric, salt and 5 cups water; pressure-cook 4 whistles and loosen with hot water.

recipes.title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead wheat flour with salt and water into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Mash boiled potatoes with chilli, coriander, ajwain, spices and salt.
Stuff dough balls with the filling and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden on both sides; serve with curd.

recipes.title: Jeera Aloo
steps: Boil, peel and cube potatoes.
Splutter cumin in oil, add chilli and spices.
Toss potatoes with salt and amchur on high heat for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Masoor Dal
steps: Pressure-cook rinsed masoor dal with turmeric and 3 cups water for 2 whistles.
Fry cumin, garlic and onion; add tomato and chilli.
Stir in dal and salt; simmer 5 minutes and finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Kadai Paneer
steps: Dry-roast and coarsely grind coriander seeds and red chillies (kadai masala).
Fry onion and ginger garlic paste; add tomato and cook down.
Add capsicum strips and half the kadai masala; cook 4 minutes.
Add paneer, remaining masala and kasuri methi; toss 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Sambar
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric until soft; mash.
Cook vegetables and drumstick in tamarind water with salt and sambar powder until tender.
Add the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil and pour over.

recipes.title: Tomato Rasam
steps: Cook toor dal until soft and mash with its water.
Boil chopped tomato, crushed garlic, tamarind water, rasam powder and salt for 10 minutes.
Add the dal water and 2 cups water; bring to a froth without boiling hard.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and asafoetida; finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Lemon Rice
steps: Fry peanuts, chana dal, mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli in oil.
Add turmeric, then the cooked rice and salt.
Turn off the heat and toss with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Curd Rice
steps: Mash slightly cooled rice with curd, milk and salt.
Temper mustard, urad dal, curry leaves, ginger and chilli in oil; mix in.
Top with pomegranate if using.

recipes.title: Masala Dosa
steps: Boil, peel and lightly mash potatoes.
Temper mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and chilli; add onion, turmeric, potato and salt.
Spread batter thin on a hot tawa, drizzle oil and cook until crisp.
Fill with potato masala and fold.

recipes.title: Ven Pongal
steps: Dry-roast moong dal lightly, then pressure-cook with rice and 5 cups water until mushy.
Fry pepper, cumin, ginger, cashews and curry leaves in ghee.
Pour over the rice-dal, add salt and mix well.

recipes.title: Avial
steps: Cut vegetables (carrot, beans, raw banana, drumstick, yam) into batons; cook with turmeric and salt.
Coarsely grind coconut, chilli and cumin.
Add the paste and whisked curd; simmer 3 minutes.
Finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.

recipes.title: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Pressure-cook rice and dal together until soft.
Cook vegetables in tamarind water with the masala powder and salt.
Combine with the rice-dal and simmer to a porridge consistency.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, asafoetida and cashews in ghee and pour over.

recipes.title: Pesarattu
steps: Soak moong and rice for 6 hours; grind with ginger, chilli and salt to a smooth batter.
Spread thin on a hot tawa and sprinkle cumin and chopped onion.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

recipes.title: Tomato Rice
steps: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onion; add ginger garlic paste.
Add chopped tomato and spices; cook to a pulp.
Add rice and 3 cups water; cook covered until done.

recipes.title: Methi Thepla
steps: Knead flour, chopped methi, curd, besan, spices and salt into a firm dough.
Roll thin rounds.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little oil until spotted on both sides.

recipes.title: Pav Bhaji
steps: Pressure-cook potato, cauliflower and peas; mash well.
Fry onion, capsicum and ginger garlic paste in butter; add tomato and pav bhaji masala.
Add the mash and water; cook and mash to a thick bhaji.
Toast pav in butter and serve with bhaji, onion, coriander and lemon.

recipes.title: Misal Pav
steps: Pressure-cook sprouts with salt for one whistle.
Roast onion and coconut, grind with tomato into a paste.
Fry the paste with misal masala in oil; add sprouts and water for a spicy curry (kat).
Serve topped with farsan, onion and coriander, with pav and lemon.

recipes.title: Varan Bhaat
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric and asafoetida until very soft; whisk smooth.
Simmer with salt and jaggery for 5 minutes.
Serve over hot rice with ghee and lemon.

recipes.title: Cholar Dal
steps: Soak chana dal 1 hour, then pressure-cook until soft but holding shape.
Fry coconut pieces in ghee; add cumin, bay leaf, red chilli and grated ginger.
Add the dal, sugar, turmeric and salt; simmer 10 minutes with raisins.

recipes.title: Aloo Posto
steps: Soak poppy seeds 30 minutes and grind with green chilli to a paste.
Fry nigella in mustard oil, add cubed potato, turmeric and salt; cook covered until tender.
Stir in the posto paste and a splash of water; cook 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until al dente, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry garlic and shredded vegetables on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add noodles, sauces, vinegar and salt; toss and finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Veg Manchurian
steps: Mix grated cabbage and carrot with maida, cornflour and salt; shape balls and deep-fry.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and spring onion in 2 tbsp oil.
Add sauces, vinegar and cornflour slurry for a glossy gravy.
Toss in the fried balls just before serving.

recipes.title: Veg Fried Rice
steps: Use day-old rice so the grains stay separate.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add rice, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt; toss well and finish with spring onion.

recipes.title: Moong Dal Chilla
steps: Soak moong dal 3 hours; grind with ginger, chilli and salt.
Stir in chopped onion, tomato, coriander and cumin.
Spread on a hot tawa and cook with a little oil until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Sabudana Khichdi
steps: Soak sabudana overnight with just enough water to cover; drain well.
Roast and coarsely crush peanuts; mix into sabudana with salt and sugar.
Fry cumin, chilli and boiled potato cubes in ghee; add sabudana and cook until pearls turn translucent.
Finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Tofu Bhurji
steps: Crumble tofu.
Fry cumin, onion, chilli and capsicum; add tomato and spices.
Add tofu and salt; cook 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Bhurji
steps: Fry onion and chilli in butter; add tomato and spices.
Pour in beaten eggs with salt and scramble on low heat until just set.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and carrot, add rice, soy sauce, pepper and salt.
Fold in eggs and spring onion.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with chopped onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, turmeric and salt.
Cook in batches in a hot pan with oil, folding when set.

recipes.title: Kerala Egg Roast
steps: Hard-boil and peel the eggs; make slits on each.
Slow-fry sliced onion in coconut oil until deep brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, curry leaves, tomato and spices; cook to a thick roast.
Coat the eggs in the masala and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, chilli powder, ginger garlic paste and salt for 30 minutes; grill or pan-sear until charred.
Simmer tomato and cashews, then blend smooth.
Cook the purée in butter with garam masala and sugar for 10 minutes.
Add chicken, cream and kasuri methi; simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, biryani masala, ginger garlic paste, mint, lemon and salt for at least an hour.
Fry sliced onions in ghee until crisp and brown.
Par-boil rice with whole spices and salt until 70% cooked.
Layer chicken, rice, fried onion, herbs and saffron milk; seal and cook on low heat for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Kadai Chicken
steps: Roast and grind coriander seeds and red chillies.
Fry onion and ginger garlic paste; add chicken and sear.
Add tomato and the kadai masala; cover and cook 20 minutes.
Add capsicum, garam masala and kasuri methi; cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chettinad Chicken
steps: Dry-roast coconut, pepper, fennel, red chillies and star anise; grind to a paste.
Fry onion and curry leaves until golden; add ginger garlic paste and tomato.
Add chicken, turmeric and salt; cook 10 minutes.
Add the paste and a little water; simmer covered for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken 65
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, flours, ginger garlic paste, chilli powder and salt for 30 minutes.
Deep-fry in batches until crisp.
Toss with fried curry leaves, chilli and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Chilli Chicken
steps: Coat chicken with egg, cornflour and salt; deep-fry until crisp.
Stir-fry garlic, chilli, onion and capsicum on high heat.
Add sauces, vinegar and a little cornflour slurry.
Toss in the chicken and spring onion.

recipes.title: Kerala Chicken Stew
steps: Fry whole spices, sliced onion, ginger and chilli in coconut oil without browning.
Add chicken, potato, carrot, salt and the thin part of the coconut milk; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the thick coconut milk and curry leaves; warm through without boiling.

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken
steps: Score the chicken; rub with lemon, salt and chilli and rest 20 minutes.
Coat in hung curd, ginger garlic paste, tandoori masala and mustard oil; marinate 4 hours or overnight.
Roast at 220°C for 30–35 minutes, basting with butter.
Serve with onion rings and lemon.

recipes.title: Kosha Mangsho
steps: Marinate mutton with curd, ginger garlic paste, chilli and salt for 2 hours.
Caramelise sugar and whole spices in mustard oil; fry onion until dark golden.
Add mutton and cook on medium heat, stirring (kosha), for 30 minutes until dark.
Add potatoes and water; cook covered until the mutton is tender, then finish with garam masala.

recipes.title: Keema Matar
steps: Fry onion until golden; add ginger garlic paste and chilli.
Add mince and cook on high, breaking it up, until browned.
Add tomato and spices, then peas; cook covered for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Rogan Josh
steps: Heat mustard oil to smoking, cool slightly, and fry whole spices and asafoetida.
Sear the mutton until browned.
Add chilli in a little water, then whisked curd, fennel and ginger powders and salt.
Cook covered on low for 75 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Macher Jhol
steps: Rub fish with salt and turmeric; shallow-fry in mustard oil and set aside.
Fry nigella and potato wedges; add ginger, tomato and powdered spices.
Add 2 cups water and simmer until potatoes are soft.
Add fish and chilli; simmer 5 minutes and finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Goan Fish Curry
steps: Grind coconut, red chillies, coriander, cumin, garlic, turmeric and tamarind into a smooth paste.
Fry onion in coconut oil; add the paste and water to a pouring consistency.
Simmer 8 minutes, then add fish and salt; cook 6 minutes without stirring hard.

recipes.title: Prawn Masala
steps: Clean and devein prawns; marinate with turmeric and salt.
Fry onion and curry leaves; add ginger garlic paste, tomato and spices.
Add ground coconut and kokum; simmer 5 minutes.
Add prawns and cook 4–5 minutes until just curled.

recipes.title: Kerala Fish Fry
steps: Coat fish slices in chilli, pepper, ginger garlic paste, turmeric, lemon and salt; rest 20 minutes.
Shallow-fry in coconut oil with curry leaves until crisp on both sides.

recipes.title: Gujarati Dal
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal until soft; whisk smooth.
Simmer with water, tomato, jaggery, kokum, turmeric and salt for 10 minutes.
Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil and pour over.

recipes.title: Lauki Chana Dal
steps: Soak chana dal 30 minutes.
Fry cumin, onion and ginger; add tomato and spices.
Add dal, cubed lauki and water; pressure-cook 3 whistles.

recipes.title: Vegetable Korma
steps: Grind cashews and coconut to a smooth paste.
Fry whole spices and onion in ghee until light golden; add ginger garlic paste.
Add vegetables, whisked curd and salt; cook 10 minutes.
Add the cashew paste and garam masala; simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Rava Idli
steps: Roast semolina in ghee with mustard, chana dal, cashews and curry leaves.
Cool, then mix with curd, grated carrot, salt and water; rest 20 minutes.
Stir in fruit salt and steam in greased moulds for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Kala Chana Masala
steps: Soak black chickpeas overnight; pressure-cook until soft.
Fry cumin, onion and ginger garlic paste; add tomato and spices.
Add chickpeas with some water and simmer 10 minutes; finish with amchur.

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka
steps: Marinate paneer, capsicum and onion pieces in hung curd, spices, mustard oil, lemon and salt for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or roast at 220°C for 12–15 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stew with Appam
steps: Fry whole spices, onion, ginger and chilli in coconut oil.
Add vegetables, salt and thin coconut milk; simmer until tender.
Stir in thick coconut milk and curry leaves.
Make appams in an appachatti with the batter and serve with the stew.
